name: Articuno
author: mashu
flavor_text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

abilities.name: Frosty Flapping
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {W} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
